info.title: Magpie Scraping Service API
info.description:
A managed scraping API that handles large request volumes, tracks progress, and delivers merged results on demand.

### Working hours

All client-facing Shopee endpoints except `/v1/shopee/get_pc` and `/v1/shopee/product-ratings` only get processed during working hours (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB). Outside working hours, clients can submit and poll jobs, but should not expect new results until processing resumes.

### Endpoints

| Endpoint | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `/v1/shopee/variant_sold_v1` | Batch scraping for up to 50,000 items per request. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB) |
| `/v1/shopee/get_pc` | Single Shopee Product Page task |
| `/v1/shopee/get_pc_bulk` | Bulk Shopee Product Page tasks by CSV |
| `/v1/shopee/pdp-bundling` | Bundle matching captured APIs per Shopee product by CSV |
| `/v1/shopee/search-items` | Scrape Shopee search/category pages up to 50 urls per request. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB) |
| `/v1/shopee/merchant-items` | Scrape Shopee merchant/shop pages up to 50 urls per request. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB) |
| `/v1/shopee/product-ratings` | Retrieve one explicit page of product ratings per request item. |
| `/v1/shopee/app/search-items` | Scrape Shopee's mobile app keyword/category search. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB) |
| `/v1/shopee/app/ratings` | Submit one product, poll job status, and retrieve aggregate 50-rating pages; approval required. |
| `/v1/tokopedia/pdp/bulk` | Bulk Tokopedia PDP scrape — submit multiple products in one request |
| `/v1/tokopedia/search/bulk` | Bulk Tokopedia search/category listing scrape |
| `/v1/tokopedia/merchant/bulk` | Bulk Tokopedia merchant product listing scrape |
| `/v1/tiktok/pdp/bulk` | Bulk TikTok Shop PDP scrape — submit multiple products in one request |
| `/v1/blibli/pdp/bulk` | Bulk Blibli PDP scrape — submit multiple products in one request |
| `/v1/blibli/merchant/bulk` | Bulk Blibli merchant product listing scrape |
| `/v1/mercadolibre/search/bulk` | Mercado Libre Search — regional batches of up to 50 listing URLs; all pages by default |
| `/v1/mercadolibre/pdp/bulk` | Mercado Libre PDP — regional batches of up to 2,000 products |
| `/v1/amazon/pdp/bulk` | Bulk Amazon PDP scrape — submit multiple products in one request |
| `/v1/amazon/search/bulk` | Bulk Amazon search/category listing scrape |
| `/v1/shopify/search/bulk` | Bulk Shopify search/collection listing scrape |
| `/v1/shopify/pdp/bulk` | Bulk Shopify PDP scrape — submit up to 2,000 product URLs in one request |
| `/v1/shopify/probe` | Check whether a Shopify domain is compatible with the scraper before submitting it |
| `/v1/lazada/product-search` | Search Lazada products by keyword, category, or seller. |
| `/v1/lazada/product-details` | Retrieve Lazada product details. |
| `/v1/lazada/product-reviews` | Retrieve Lazada product reviews through the V1 API. |
| `/v1/lazada/product-reviews-v2` | Retrieve Lazada product reviews through the H5 V2 API. |
| `/v1/lazada/category-tree` | Retrieve the Lazada category tree. |
| `/v1/lazada/seller-directory` | Retrieve the Lazada seller directory. |
| `/v1/lazada/seller-details` | Retrieve Lazada seller details. |
| `/v1/lazada/seller-promotions` | Retrieve Lazada seller campaigns and promoted products. |
| `/v1/lazada/keyword-tracking` | Retrieve Lazada keyword tracking logs. |

### How it works

1. **Submit** your request via the desired endpoint.
2. Listing-product jobs are **queued for processing** through an operational readiness gate.
3. Poll the **retrieve** endpoint to check progress.
4. Once complete, use the **download** endpoint to fetch results.

### Credits

Every endpoint is billed in prepaid credits — per item, per URL, or per request.
Balance is checked at submit time; insufficient balance returns `402 Payment
Required`. Most endpoints deduct upfront; gated Shopee jobs are charged when
processing starts. Items that don't complete are refunded.

**Live per-endpoint rate card → https://data.magpieiq.com/pricing/api**

Costs are not listed here on purpose: they're set in the pricing table and can
change without redeploying this service, so the rate card is the only place
guaranteed to match what you're charged.

### Authentication

All endpoints (except `/health`) require a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <your-opaque-token> (Contact us for trial access)
```

### Supported countries

`id`, `sg`, `th`, `ph`, `my`, `vn`, `tw`, `br`

### How jobs work

Authentication, the approval flow, job statuses, and credits/refunds are the same
across every endpoint below — see **How jobs work** →
https://data.magpieiq.com/docs/scraping/how-jobs-work for the full reference.
Each endpoint's own docs below cover only what's specific to it: its request
shape, supported URL formats, and result data.

post.description:
Accepts up to **50,000 items**, one country per request, and chunks each group into batches of 50 (for background processing). This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB)

**Billed per item_id** — balance checked at submit, charged on approval; insufficient balance returns `402`. Current credit cost: [rate card](https://data.magpieiq.com/pricing/api).

Starts in `awaiting_approval` with **no credits deducted yet**. The team is notified and waits for approval (24h timeout). **Credits are only deducted when approved.** On rejection or timeout, the job ends in `rejected` with no charge.

Returns `202 Accepted` with a `job_id` for polling via `GET /retrieve/{job_id}`.

202.description: Job accepted; awaiting approval or already queued.

402.description: Insufficient quota balance. Response includes `required`, `current`, and `shortfall`.

422.description: Payload validation failed (bad country code or schema).

200.description: Job found; returns status and per-batch details.

404.description: Job not found, or not owned by the authenticated user.

If the job has not yet been completed, `download_url` will be `null` and the counts will reflect current progress.

get.summary: Retrieve Shopee Product Page bulk task progress
get.description:
Returns per-row progress counts and, once the batch finishes, a `download_url` for the merged result — for a `task_id` returned by `POST /v1/shopee/get_pc_bulk/submit`.

Each row's result is the same product-page JSON as `GET /v1/shopee/get_pc/retrieve/{task_id}` — see its **Result data** example. `result_format=csv` (default) stores that JSON as an escaped string column; `result_format=jsonl` writes it as the `response` field of each JSONL line.

post.summary: Bundle captured APIs for up to 2,000 unique Shopee products
post.description:
Upload UTF-8 CSV: `region,shop_id,item_id
id,123,456`. Duplicate products are removed before charging. Billed per successful product. Result format: csv or jsonl. Normal export waits until task success plus five minutes; retrieval reports capture_wait meanwhile.

get.description:
Returns per-product progress counts and, once the batch finishes, a `download_url` for the merged result — for a `task_id` returned by `POST /v1/shopee/pdp-bundling/submit`. Export waits five minutes after a product succeeds to include later captures; keep polling while the message is `capture_wait`.

**Result data** (one product's bundle, trimmed to 1 of 6 captured responses):
```json
{
  "task_id": 38037366,
  "region": "id",
  "shop_id": "502905699",
  "item_id": "14060578207",
  "responses": [
    {
      "id": 120383267,
      "timestamp": "2026-10-08T04:29:57.038813+00:00",
      "api_url": "https://shopee.co.id/api/v4/item/get_rating_variation_filters?itemid=...",
      "page_url": "https://shopee.co.id/product/502905699/14060578207",
      "payload": { "...": "original Shopee API response for this capture" }
    }
  ]
}
```
CSV stores `responses` as a JSON string in one column; JSONL keeps it as a native array.

[Download full example (JSON)](https://data.magpieiq.com/samples/scraping/shopee-pdp-bundling.json)

post.description:
Submits multiple URLs to scrape items from Shopee search or category pages. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB). Up to 50 urls per request.

**Billed per page** — deducted upfront; insufficient balance returns `402`. Current credit cost: [rate card](https://data.magpieiq.com/pricing/api).

**Sorting & filters — set them in the URL, exactly like the Shopee website:**
- no `sortBy` → Popularity (default)
- `sortBy=ctime` → Newest — e.g. `https://shopee.co.id/Maskara-cat.11043145.11043212.11043216?page=0&sortBy=ctime`
- `sortBy=sales` → Best seller — e.g. `https://shopee.co.id/Maskara-cat.11043145.11043212.11043216?page=0&sortBy=sales`

You can also append any filter the site supports (location, price range, etc.) as URL parameters — copy the URL from the website with your filters/sort applied.

The job is queued for processing. Poll `GET /retrieve/{job_id}` to check progress.

get.description:
Returns the current status and per-URL results when complete. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB).

Region is auto-detected from each URL's host (e.g. `shopee.co.id` → `id`, `shopee.com.br` → `br`). Each successful item's `download_url` points at `GET /v1/shopee/pgnt/jobs/{job_id}/items/{item_token}/data` and returns all items from `search_items` across every fetched page.

**Result data** (one URL's downloaded result, trimmed):

post.description:
Submits multiple URLs to scrape all items from Shopee merchant/shop pages. This endpoint only gets processed during working hours (Monday-Friday, 08:00-17:00 Asia/Jakarta / WIB). Up to 50 urls per request.

**Billed per page** — deducted upfront; insufficient balance returns `402`. Current credit cost: [rate card](https://data.magpieiq.com/pricing/api).

**Sorting & filters — set them in the URL, exactly like the Shopee website:**
- no `sortBy` → Popularity (default)
- `sortBy=ctime` → Newest — append `?page=0&sortBy=ctime` to the shop URL
- `sortBy=sales` → Best seller — append `?page=0&sortBy=sales`

You can also append any filter the site supports (location, price range, etc.) as URL parameters — copy the URL from the website with your filters/sort applied.

The job is queued for processing. Poll `GET /retrieve/{job_id}` to check progress.

post.summary: Submit a batch of Tokopedia PDP scrape tasks
post.description:
Queues many Tokopedia PDP scrape tasks in one request. Accepts a JSON array of `{product_key, shop_domain}` pairs (max 2,000 per batch).

**Billed per item** — deducted upfront; insufficient balance returns `402`. Current credit cost: [rate card](https://data.magpieiq.com/pricing/api).

The batch is recorded in NocoDB `jobs`/`items` immediately (all items start `PENDING`) and handed off asynchronously to a Windmill flow which publishes each item to RabbitMQ, waits for results in GCS, and updates item statuses. Poll `/v1/tokopedia/pdp/bulk/retrieve/{job_id}` for the aggregated batch status, or use each item's `task_id` with the existing single-item `/v1/tokopedia/pdp/retrieve/{task_id}` endpoint.

get.summary: Retrieve aggregated status for an Amazon PDP bulk batch
get.description:
Returns aggregate counts (total/success/failed/pending) and a single batch-level `download_url` for the compiled JSONL file once ready.

While scraping is in progress, `status` is `processing` and `download_url` is null. After all items reach a terminal state, the Windmill flow compiles individual result JSON files into a single gzip-compressed JSONL file. If the JSONL is not yet present, `status` remains `processing` with `message` set to `merging_results`. Once the JSONL is available, `download_url` contains a 24-hour signed URL.

Responses are cached: 120 seconds while processing, 24 hours once the JSONL is ready.

**Result data** (one JSONL line, trimmed):
```json
{
  "item_id": "B018IZAME2",
  "country": "sg",
  "response": {
    "title": "Sample Amazon Product Title",
    "brand": "Sample Brand",
    "price": {"amount": 29.99, "currency": "SGD", "original_price": 39.99},
    "availability": "In Stock",
    "rating": 4.5,
    "review_count": 1234,
    "seller": {"name": "Sample Seller", "id": "A123456789"}
  }
}
```

[Download full example (JSON)](https://data.magpieiq.com/samples/scraping/amazon-pdp-bulk.json)

post.summary: Submit a batch of Mercado Libre PDP scrape tasks
post.description:
Queues many Mercado Libre PDP scrape tasks in one request. Accepts a JSON array of `{product_id, product_url}` items (max 2,000 per batch). One region per batch; all 18 configured worker regions are accepted. Exact HTTPS URLs are required.

get.summary: Retrieve aggregated status for an Mercado Libre PDP bulk batch
get.description:
Returns aggregate counts (total/success/failed/pending) and a single batch-level `download_url` for the compiled JSONL file once ready.

While scraping is in progress, `status` is `processing` and `download_url` is null. After all items reach a terminal state, the Windmill flow compiles individual result JSON files into a single gzip-compressed JSONL file. If the JSONL is not yet present, the terminal job status is retained with `message` set to `merging_results`. Once the JSONL is available, `download_url` contains a signed URL with the configured download expiry.

Responses are cached: 120 seconds while processing, 24 hours once the JSONL is ready. Each JSONL line is shaped like `GET /v1/mercadolibre/pdp/retrieve/{task_id}` — see its **Result data** example.

[Download full example (JSON)](https://data.magpieiq.com/samples/scraping/mercadolibre-pdp-bulk.json)

Returns the status and scraped result for a single product within a `/v1/mercadolibre/pdp/bulk` submission, addressed by the per-item `task_id` returned in that batch's `submit`/`retrieve` response (not the batch's own `job_id`). `response` is the full captured page state (rendered DOM JSON), not a normalized product object.

**Result data** (`response`, trimmed):
```json
{
  "product_id": "MLM1027172667",
  "region": "MX",
  "capture": {
    "requested_url": "https://www.mercadolibre.com.mx/apple-iphone-15-128-gb-azul-...",
    "captured_at_utc": "2026-10-08T03:11:20.032930+00:00",
    "http_status": 200,
    "capture_source": "rendered_dom"
  }
}
```
The real payload additionally nests the page's rendering context (title, price, images, schema.org product block, reviews, analytics payloads) — omitted here for brevity.
